Saturated +/-1 edges reduce the problem to two integer counts and, by diagonal and boundary monotonicity, a single nearest-integer square. This proves the closed formula, equality cases, parity and balancing. Independent direct signed-edge enumeration for (a,b)=(1,1),(2,1),(2,2),(3,2),(6,2) corroborated, and exact algebraic comparison for 324 pairs 2<=a,b<=19 proved equality with the earlier bistar polar norm formula. Finite tests support, do not replace, the universal proof.
